# vocabulary: is the statement written in reviewed words?

A Lean statement is only as faithful as the definitions it uses. This test checks that every constant in the
statement (its type, not its proof) is from core Lean or belongs to a definition or assumption node, each of
which a person reviews once. A new theorem that passes inherits most of its faithfulness from those reviews.

<!-- tests:begin (generated by `dagtool readmes`; edit the test docstrings, not this table) -->
| Test | What it checks | A pass grants |
|---|---|---|
| [`vocabulary/vetted_constants`](vetted_constants.py) | Every constant in the Lean statement comes from core Lean or a vetted node. | Tested (faithfulness): the statement is written in reviewed vocabulary. |
